newsitem.title: CHINA: PRESS DIGEST - Chinese newspapers - March 3.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Chinese newspapers - March 3.

text.p: Following is a summary of major Chinese political and business stories in leading newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Beijing. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy. Telephone: (8610) 6532-1921. Fax: (8610) 6532-4978.
- Deng Xiaoping's ashes are cast into the sea
- Second plenary session of Fifth meeting of the Eighth National People's Congress held Sunday.
- Chen Jinhua, minister in charge of State Planning Commission, reports planning on national economy
- Minister of Finance Liu Zhongli delivers budget
- Premier Li Peng calls for accelerating efforts to translate scientific and technological achievements into productive forces
- Politburo member Li Ruihuan asks CPPCC deputies to cherish unity and stability
- Vice-premier Zhu Rongji calls for opening of minds and bolder steps to further development.
- China law makers hold different views on drafting of Securities Law, say needs more work
- China electric power industry expects foreign investment to account for 20 percent of total by 2000
- Chinese President Jiang Zemin calls for accelerating the development in central and western China
- State Planning Commission Minister Chen Jinhua aims for moderate yet stable pace of development
- Government will continue moderately tight fiscal policies this year, says Minister of Finance Liu Zhongli
